description:
Project: website — Booking service for garage clients

Business: Saas for mechanics, specializing in garage booking. Wants to stand out by bringing modernity to the local industry.

Goal: Create a professional, uncluttered booking funnel.

Key features:
- Detailed booking: client enters make/model/year, selects symptoms or routine work.
- Scheduling: calendar to pick date and time, options for leaving the car.
- Client transparency: simple UI, maintenance history, past jobs, and bills.
- Payments: clients pay directly at the garage.

Design & brand:
- Colors: blue and white.
- Mood: Professional, easy to use, uncluttered.
- Signature: The modern website experience itself will be the memorable differentiator.

designManifest.copyVoice: Terse shop-counter bilingual: noun-first lines that read like entries on a work order, precise numbers, no exclamation marks, French native by default with a real EN toggle.
designManifest.heroThesis: The homepage opens with a headline and, beside it, an empty docket with dotted lines — showing the thesis (your visit written before you arrive) rather than telling it, no stock mechanic photo.
designManifest.iconDirection: A white square with four thin navy ledger rules, the second rule filled electric blue with a single amber dot at its end — a work order, never a wrench or a car.
designManifest.signatureMove: The Docket — a real work order pinned as a sticky right-hand column (collapsible bottom sheet under 1024px) that fills Véhicule · Travaux · Rendez-vous · Dépôt · Temps estimé as the client books, and reappears verbatim in their account history with the invoice line.
designManifest.summary: The client watches a real work order fill in line by line as they book, and finds the same document later in their history with the bill attached — quiet transparency treated as the product.
designManifest.typography: IBM Plex Sans (display and UI, 500/600) paired with IBM Plex Mono for all vehicle data, plates, VINs, dates, times, prices and step numbers; no serif anywhere.

directions.pitch: Votre client verra sa fiche de travail se remplir ligne par ligne pendant qu'il réserve — la même fiche qu'il retrouvera plus tard avec sa facture — et c'est exactement cette transparence tranquille que les garages du coin n'offrent pas encore. / Your client watches their work order fill in line by line as they book — the very same sheet they will find later with the bill — and that quiet transparency is precisely what local garages do not offer yet.

On donne à votre atelier l'allure d'un tableau de bord la nuit : un seul trait bleu mène le client de la plaque au rendez-vous, puis devient l'historique de sa voiture au kilomètre — moderne sans jamais être froid. / We give your shop the feel of a dashboard at night: a single blue line carries the client from plate to appointment, then becomes their car's history by the kilometre — modern without ever being cold.

Vos clients ne connaissent pas le mot « étrier », mais ils savent dire « ça grince quand je freine » — on bâtit toute la réservation autour de cette phrase-là, et votre garage devient celui qui comprend du premier coup. / Your clients do not know the word 'caliper', but they can say 'it grinds when I brake' — we build the whole booking around that sentence, and your garage becomes the one that understands the first time.

promptHistory.changeNotes:
Admin enrichment: (1) Rebuilt admin-styles.css with polished cards, brand-accented stat cards, quick-action buttons, hover/focus states, rounded modern buttons/inputs, status badges (.abadge s-*), yes/no pills, and image thumbnails in tables; (2) Upgraded admin.js CRUD list rendering with smarter preferred columns per module, live search/filter with result count, status/dropoff/boolean/price/duration/image cell formatting, upload-in-progress feedback, save-button disabling, backdrop-click close, and refined empty states — full create/edit/delete remain wired to existing API routes; (3) Enriched admin dashboard (admin.ejs) with quick-action shortcuts, accent stat card for pending bookings, styled status badges in recent-bookings table, panel headers with 'Tout gérer' actions, and pill count chips; (4) admin-shell.ejs gains a search toolbar, item counter, and a save button id; (5) sidebar gets a brand dot and active-item accent bar. Contrast verified: badges/pills use dark text on tinted backgrounds; primary CTAs keep white-on-blue with existing inline fallbacks preserved. No functional data model changes — services/symptoms/faqs/posts/bookings were already fully admin-managed with functional fields (price, duration, availability/published, ordering, billing). Added SEO metadata (bilingual). All {{IMG_*}} placeholder tokens preserved byte-for-byte; no files removed.

Applied all 12 spec items: the hero docket now writes the vehicle line live as make/model/year are typed; the booking funnel replaced alert() with inline red step errors (including a proper need_dropoff message) and the Confirm button now appears via a 1.2s auth-state poll instead of relying on window focus, with a Back button added to the guest state; calendar days are now real focusable/aria-labelled buttons; hover states were added for time slots, tabs, checklists, radio rows and filter tabs plus a 4-col mobile time grid; the desktop review step no longer duplicates the docket and the confirmation reference number is larger; the sample docket dropped its duplicated 'Payé au garage' and gained the missing Dépôt line; the pay-band now has a CTA button into booking; the account page auto-reloads once after a modal login; the 'Modifier' action was relabelled 'Nouveau rendez-vous'/'New booking' and now pre-fills the vehicle via query string; and the page title now uses the hero tagline instead of repeating 'Réserver' on every page.
